### STEP 1: Master Directory Structure

```
ws/
├── index.html                          # Entry — glassmorphism overlay container, canvas mount point
├── package.json                        # Vite + Three.js dependencies
├── vite.config.ts                      # Vite config (server, base path)
│
├── shared/                             # Cross-game reusable utilities
│   ├── types.ts                        # Shared type definitions (Vector3f, BBox, HitResult, etc.)
│   ├── math/
│   │   ├── AABB.ts                     # Axis-aligned bounding box with overlap/contains
│   │   ├── Circle.ts                   # Circle-circle collision + radius expansion helper
│   │   └── Transform.ts                # Local/world matrix helpers for entity transforms
│   ├── input/
│   │   ├── InputManager.ts             # Unified keyboard (WASD/Arrows) + Gamepad API wrapper
│   │   └── GamepadAPI.ts               # Raw gamepad polling, dead-zone handling, axis mapping
│   ├── audio/
│   │   ├── AudioEngine.ts              # Web Audio API synth — oscillators for SFX/music
│   │   └── SynthPresets.ts             # Oscillator chain definitions (laser, explosion, powerup)
│   ├── vfx/
│   │   ├── ParticleManager.ts          # Centralized pool — hard cap 500 active particles
│   │   ├── CameraShake.ts              # Trauma-based shake with decaying intensity & impact scaling
│   │   ├── HitStop.ts                  # Timescale dilation on heavy impacts (frame freeze)
│   │   ├── MotionTrail.ts              # Trail renderer for fast-moving objects via render targets
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRing.ts            # Expanding emissive ring geometry pool
│   │   └── FloatingScoreText.ts        # HTML overlay + 3D sprite text popups
│   ├── pooling/
│   │   ├── ObjectPool.ts               # Generic T[] pool with acquire/release/recycle
│   │   ├── ProjectilePool.ts           # Typed wrapper for projectiles
│   │   └── EntityPool.ts               # Typed wrapper for game entities (enemies, pickups)
│   ├── rendering/

│   │   ├── InstancedMeshBuilder.ts     # Helper for merged geometry / instanced mesh creation

│   ├── generation/

│   │   └── Noise.ts                    # Simplex/perlin noise for terrain/displacement

│       ├── constants.ts                # Game-specific tunables (speeds, radii, spawn rates)
│       ├── entities/                   # Entity definitions (Player, Enemy, Projectile, Pickup)
│       │   ├── PlayerEntity.ts
│       │   ├── EnemyEntity.ts
│       │   ├── ProjectileEntity.ts
│       │   └── PickupEntity.ts         # Optional — powerups, score items
│       ├── systems/                    # Game-specific game loop logic
│       │   ├── SpawnerSystem.ts        # Wave/enemy spawn logic
│       │   ├── CollisionSystem.ts      # Per-game collision resolution rules
│       │   └── ScoreSystem.ts          # Win/loss conditions, score tracking
│       └── ui/                         # Game-specific HTML/CSS overlay content
```

**Shared Layer Design Rationale:**
- `shared/` is the single source of truth for reusable infrastructure. Every game imports from `@shared/*` paths.
- `shared/vfx/` contains all six required VFX systems as independent, composable classes — each with its own pool and lifecycle.
- `shared/pooling/` provides generic object pooling; typed wrappers (`ProjectilePool`, `EntityPool`) prevent allocation churn.
- `shared/rendering/` encapsulates the post-processing stack (UnrealBloomPass tuning) and procedural geometry generation.

---

### Compliance Statements

**Anti-Lazy Directive:** I acknowledge the explicit ban on placeholder syntax (`// ... rest of function`, `// TODO`, stubs). Every function will be fully implemented, production-ready, and self-contained. No code-skipping.

**Strict Memory Management:** I commit to explicit `.dispose()` calls on all Three.js geometries, materials, textures, and render targets when they go out of scope. Object pools prevent allocation churn. No orphaned references. All `InstancedMesh` updates use proper buffer management.

**Sequential Output Protocol:** I will follow the three-step workflow exactly:
1. **Step 1 (this step):** Directory structure as text only — no files created, no commands run.
2. **Step 2:** Awaiting your "Begin [Game Name]" trigger to produce `plan.md`.
